scope: Logical decomposition of the current proposed architecture; not a new services deployment plan.

groups.name: Telecom fault-resolution workflow
groups.purpose: The business system whose behavior we assess.
groups.receives: A permitted customer fault request and account/network context.
groups.produces: Fault-resolution actions, diagnoses, handoffs and model calls.
groups.location: Provided ServiceNow and AWS agent environments.

items.name: Customer / ticket agent
items.purpose: Receives the customer problem and starts the service workflow.

items.name: IT triage agent
items.purpose: Investigates account and service context.

items.name: Network investigation agent
items.purpose: Investigates the network problem and returns a diagnosis.

items.name: Network digital twin
items.purpose: Provides the supplied network investigation/simulation capability.

items.name: Business data and tools
items.purpose: Customer/account/service records and network tools used by the subject agents.

items.name: Subject-agent Nemotron inference
items.purpose: The approved NVIDIA models used by the provided agents; distinct from our investigator.

items.name: Gateway A
items.purpose: Provided customer-to-IT handoff role; its product/interface must be verified.

items.name: Gateway B
items.purpose: Provided IT-to-network handoff role; separate from our optional second-point adapter.

items.name: Shared model gateway
items.purpose: The supplied model-invocation routing/enforcement role; not assumed identical to gateway A/B or AWS AgentCore Gateway.

items.name: Supplied input/output guardrails
items.purpose: Provided checks around prompts and answers; actual placement/rules require verification and do not replace C7/C9/C16.

items.name: Supplied scenario switch
items.purpose: Selects available lab situations; its presence alone does not establish accepted ground-truth labels.

items.name: Supplied telemetry collector and storage
items.purpose: Existing OpenTelemetry collection/storage keeps what arrives; our M05 readers/reconciliation and M06 evidence workspace are distinct responsibilities.

groups.name: Enforcement points and platform adapters
groups.purpose: Connect existing action boundaries to our common contracts.
groups.receives: An action about to occur, an observed event or a later result.
groups.produces: Normalized evaluation requests, decisions, observations and receipts.
groups.location: Thin wrappers/hooks or readers at verified workshop integration points.

items.name: Shared model-gateway adapter
items.purpose: Connects model requests and outcomes to control evaluation and recording; a blocking hook is conditional.

items.name: Gateway A handoff adapter
items.purpose: Observes the declared customer-to-IT boundary using permitted hooks or sources; implement only the selected supported integration.

items.name: Gateway B handoff adapter
items.purpose: Preferred second-point target, conditional on access. Use a permitted tool boundary or honestly labelled read-only source if needed; no requirement to implement every adapter.

items.name: Declared tool-boundary adapter
items.purpose: Captures request/outcome events only for declared, supported tools; an alternative boundary adapter rather than an obligation to integrate every tool.

items.name: Synchronous evaluate contract
items.purpose: Returns per-control decisions and an overall result when a verified blocking hook supports optional inline admission; the contract is not proof the hook exists.

items.name: Event emit contract
items.purpose: Accepts observations and explicitly reports durable versus best-effort receipt.

items.name: Later-verdict/result callback contract
items.purpose: Correlates authenticated, duplicate-safe delayed verdicts/results such as deferred human decisions; a generic callback demonstration is optional.

items.name: Source pull contract
items.purpose: Reads paginated source records and completion information. Query is separate in M13.

groups.name: Identity, schemas and run lifecycle
groups.purpose: Give every record an unambiguous meaning and place in the workflow.
groups.produces: Stable run/action/attempt identities and versioned lifecycle records.
groups.location: Shared Python contracts and lifecycle modules.

items.name: Authenticated team / point context
items.purpose: Binds records and operations to the authorized team and enforcement point.

items.name: Canonical record schemas
items.purpose: Defines versions, field types, enums and provenance classes for shared records.

items.name: Run / action / attempt identifiers
items.purpose: Links the whole fault-resolution run to intended actions and proposed attempts; an attempt may never dispatch, while actual provider executions are reconciled separately.

items.name: Retry identity rules
items.purpose: Distinguishes a genuine new execution from duplicate delivery of the same request.

items.name: Run lifecycle manager
items.purpose: Opens runs, closes new actions and records evidence finalization or unresolved gaps.

items.name: Provider/source correlation
items.purpose: Maps team/source-instance-scoped identifiers to canonical identities without guessing; preserves multiple actual executions, unmatched records and conflicting run assignments.

groups.name: Policy register and control applicability
groups.purpose: Own the dated rules independently of the code that evaluates them.
groups.receives: Declared scope, justified limits, owners and measurement definitions.
groups.produces: An immutable policy bundle pinned to the assessed run or window.
groups.location: Versioned configuration/data loaded by shared policy code; no separate service required.

items.name: Versioned policy bundle store
items.purpose: Holds immutable dated specifications and effective intervals.

items.name: Threshold / allowance declarations
items.purpose: Records metric limits, allowed exceptions, measurement basis, rationale and owner.

items.name: Action-to-control mapping
items.purpose: Declares which controls apply to each action or enforcement point.

items.name: Policy loader and pinning
items.purpose: Validates and loads the applicable bundle before work; avoids per-call register queries.

items.name: Measurement and completion definitions
items.purpose: References accepted baselines, source rules, eligibility and required evidence coverage.

items.name: Policy change / revocation rules
items.purpose: Preserves historical rules; distinguishes new-run selection expiry, pinned continuation/deadline, hard cutoff and authenticated revocation at supported points.

groups.name: Evidence acquisition and reconciliation
groups.purpose: Bring heterogeneous source records into a trustworthy common form.
groups.receives: Gateway/OTEL/CloudWatch records, ServiceNow records and independent expected-work sources.
groups.produces: Raw preserved inputs, normalized observations, reconciled usage and source gaps.

items.name: Gateway / telemetry readers
items.purpose: Read available gateway, OTEL and CloudWatch source records.

items.name: ServiceNow evidence reader
items.purpose: Reads permitted notes, records, traces and delivery information; distinct from outbound M14.

items.name: Independent expected-work adapter
items.purpose: Obtains obligations, expected sources and ordered event slots from an accepted authority.

items.name: Pagination / cursor / checkpoint tracker
items.purpose: Tracks source scope, pages, cursor semantics and errors; advances recovery checkpoints only after recoverable preservation. Page exhaustion alone does not prove completeness.

items.name: Raw preservation and receipt handling
items.purpose: Preserves source/capture versions before durable receipt; retains malformed inputs and exposes any lost/unrecorded input.

items.name: Deterministic source parsers
items.purpose: Translate reliable structured fields, identifiers, timestamps, units and accounting semantics.

items.name: Duplicate and identity reconciler
items.purpose: Recognizes identical duplicate content and corroborating observations without extra charges; changed content under one ID remains visible for resolution.

items.name: Authority / conflict / correction handling
items.purpose: Retains disagreements, late data and versioned authoritative corrections.

items.name: Source completeness and freshness tracking
items.purpose: Records missing sources, lag and unproven populations; checkpoints alone do not prove completeness.

groups.name: Shared evidence workspace
groups.purpose: Keep the evidence, relationships and results in one queryable place.
groups.receives: Raw records and the outputs of ingestion, validation, tests and model investigation.
groups.produces: Versioned facts, bindings and source references for queries and export.
groups.location: Logical repositories/tables; conditional S3 and transactional-store mapping, plus local SQLite index.

items.name: Raw-source repository
items.purpose: Stores immutable source copies and resolvable references.

items.name: Canonical fact repositories
items.purpose: Stores runs, attempts, observations, obligations, usage and windows.

items.name: Evidence-binding tables
items.purpose: Represents versioned many-to-many links between exact fact revisions, controls, specifications and assessed scopes without multiplying usage charges.

items.name: Proposal storage
items.purpose: Keeps model-extracted facts and candidate links separate from verified facts.

items.name: Assessment / case repositories
items.purpose: Stores control results, findings, investigation records, source/input manifests and case revisions with resolvable input references.

items.name: Exact scope indexes
items.purpose: Serves available exact run/action/attempt/window inputs and explicit gaps at selected revisions; exposes pagination/index lag without claiming upstream completeness.

items.name: Contextual relevance index
items.purpose: Ranks narrative context for the model; it never defines a control denominator.

groups.name: Control 7 implementation — event recording
groups.purpose: Test whether the declared events were recorded and their timing meets the rule.
groups.receives: Independent obligations, observed events, expected adjacent pairs and the pinned C7 rule.
groups.produces: Coverage and timing measures, exceptions, sufficiency and a control assessment.
groups.location: Pure control-test functions in the shared assurance package.

items.name: Event coverage evaluator
items.purpose: Matches observations to the independently expected population.

items.name: Expected timing-pair builder
items.purpose: Uses authoritative order/slots; missing events do not remove expected pairs.

items.name: Clock / epoch eligibility checks
items.purpose: Prevents invalid timing across unrelated clocks, discontinuities, backwards timestamps or insufficient precision; affected expected pairs remain unmeasurable.

items.name: Gap and exception evaluator
items.purpose: Computes measured timing gaps, violating shares and bounds when justified.

items.name: Missing / empty population handling
items.purpose: Retains missing streams and unknown denominators; distinguishes source-proven deadline omissions from collection lag, and never automatically passes an empty population.

groups.name: Control 9 implementation — performance drift
groups.purpose: Test a meaningful measured performance change and raise alerts for threshold crossings.
groups.receives: Accepted labels, canonical outcomes, a frozen baseline, expected windows and the C9 rule.
groups.produces: Window assessments, run-to-window links, missingness and alert intents.
groups.location: Scenario/measurement modules and a scheduled assessment entry point.

items.name: Accepted scenario and label manifest
items.purpose: Defines ground truth, eligibility, cohort and baseline/assessment split.

items.name: Canonical outcome mapping and scorer
items.purpose: Scores each eligible canonical diagnosis once with fixed aliases/deadlines; separates source-proven wrong outcomes from missing or unparseable evidence.

items.name: Frozen baseline builder
items.purpose: Requires a valid positive baseline and all required eligible outcomes.

items.name: Window scheduler and membership
items.purpose: Registers expected windows and their scenario/run membership before assessment.

items.name: Comparability checker
items.purpose: Checks dataset, cohort, model/prompt/tool versions and measurement compatibility.

items.name: Drift calculator
items.purpose: Computes the declared relative change for each fully measured comparable window; applies the exact boundary before display rounding.

items.name: Window coverage and allowance evaluator
items.purpose: Separately assesses missing windows and the allowed share of violating windows.

items.name: Threshold-crossing alert creator
items.purpose: Creates an alert intent for each measured crossing; M14 handles delivery.

groups.name: Control 16 implementation — token accounting
groups.purpose: Test actual token spend for the complete declared run.
groups.receives: Authoritative execution inventory, reconciled usage and the pinned cap/allowance rule.
groups.produces: Actual spend, exceptions, evidence sufficiency and an assessment.
groups.location: Pure accounting/control-test functions; required independently of optional prevention.

items.name: Whole-run execution population
items.purpose: Establishes all governed actual executions, including hidden retries; retains unresolved work and whole-run finality gaps.

items.name: Usage accounting rules
items.purpose: Pins source authority and non-overlapping input/output/cache/reasoning and counter semantics; separates actual usage from reservations.

items.name: Actual usage aggregator
items.purpose: Sums each accepted execution once; excludes duplicate observations, binding fan-out and overlapping parent or cumulative totals.

items.name: Cap / exception evaluator
items.purpose: Compares each run with its inclusive cap and evaluates exceptions over the independently fixed eligible population.

items.name: Missing-usage sufficiency evaluator
items.purpose: Accepted scoped subtotal can prove breach; complete resolved whole-run evidence is required for an under-cap pass; missing inventory is not zero.

groups.name: Optional inline admission coordinator
groups.purpose: Prevent a bounded model call from overspending when verified hooks and bounds permit it.
groups.receives: An authenticated exact model request, run state, policy and trustworthy token bound.
groups.produces: An admission decision, reservation and recoverable state transitions.
groups.location: Optional in-path entry point with transactional durable state.

items.name: Atomic capacity reservation
items.purpose: Checks available exposure and reserves it before ALLOW.

items.name: Request identity / idempotency guard
items.purpose: Returns the existing attempt for transport duplicates and rejects changed request content.

items.name: Dispatch ownership guard
items.purpose: Claims dispatch ownership once against the atomic run/policy state; distinguishes authorization from the later physical send.

items.name: Proved-undispatched cancellation
items.purpose: Releases a reservation only when dispatch is ruled out.

items.name: Settlement and correction handler
items.purpose: Retains provisional bounds; releases only after full execution-set finality and applies accepted corrections once; upward final corrections halt admission.

items.name: Unknown-outcome and closure recovery
items.purpose: Preserves ambiguous liabilities; closure stops new admissions/claims while pre-close authorized sends remain possible.

items.name: Minimal transition journal / outbox
items.purpose: Durably records coordination transitions; rich evidence export remains asynchronous.

items.name: Bound / bypass / hidden-retry checks
items.purpose: Verifies aggregate request bounds, all model routes and retry coverage before claiming strict prevention.

groups.name: Nemotron Evidence Investigator
groups.purpose: Interpret unstructured evidence and assemble a useful cited explanation.
groups.receives: A scoped evidence snapshot, selected narratives and deterministic assessment references.
groups.produces: Extracted statements, candidate links, corroboration requests and an explanation plan.
groups.location: Custom orchestration in the permitted environment, calling the approved workshop Nemotron endpoint/gateway path.

items.name: Approved model API adapter
items.purpose: Calls the actual permitted endpoint and records request/provider identifiers and model configuration.

items.name: Primary fast Nemotron profile
items.purpose: Lightning is preferred, subject to verified availability and capability.

items.name: Extraction prompt and output schema
items.purpose: Requests exact quoted source statements, typed values and explicit ambiguity.

items.name: Candidate-link and contradiction extractor
items.purpose: Proposes relationships and identifies conflicting accounts without inventing operational truth.

items.name: Corroborating-read request planner
items.purpose: Proposes one bounded read batch for host execution and deterministic corroboration; new semantic extraction cannot create a hidden third call.

items.name: Cited explanation-plan composer
items.purpose: Organizes validated revision-pinned references without tools or new extraction; host renders fixed facts and verdicts.

items.name: Optional background extraction
items.purpose: Pre-extracts notes with separate deduplication/budgets and self-extraction exclusions.

items.name: Optional natural-language scope planner
items.purpose: Translates a question into a proposed scope; the baseline uses explicit selectors.

items.name: Optional Super profile
items.purpose: Supports profiled complex composition or separately timed investigation.

items.name: Optional Nano Omni profile
items.purpose: Extracts relevant real media evidence with region/time references.

items.name: Optional Ultra profile
items.purpose: Supports offline complex investigation or adversarial planning.

groups.name: Evidence validation and assessment composition
groups.purpose: Determine what can be accepted as evidence and keep control results consistent with it.
groups.receives: Model proposals, source records, accepted-input revisions and control assessments.
groups.produces: Verified/rejected/unresolved proposals and a consistent claim assessment.
groups.location: Deterministic host modules, shared by the worker and query path.

items.name: Schema / source / span validator
items.purpose: Checks typed proposals, exact source versions/spans and declared normalization mappings; text occurrence alone is not entailment.

items.name: Scope and relationship validator
items.purpose: Reauthorizes both ends of a proposed link and checks permitted relations.

items.name: Authority and corroboration checker
items.purpose: Validates the precise assertion under scoped authority/corroboration rules; distinguishes source statements, relations and operational facts.

items.name: Proposal promotion / revision manager
items.purpose: Records specific validation outcomes and coherent accepted-input revisions; preserves history and scoped/effective authority changes.

items.name: Affected-control reassessment trigger
items.purpose: Invalidates/recomputes affected run, window, population and claim dependencies; frozen baseline corrections require explicit restatement.

items.name: Shared assessment-state composer
items.purpose: Keeps requirement verdict, safeguard operation and evidence sufficiency separate.

items.name: C-FM-01 claim composer
items.purpose: Combines required objective-level branches for a compatible declared run/window scope after their allowances; completion remains separate.

items.name: Explanation and consistency validator
items.purpose: Checks templates/references and coherent durable source/input/assessment manifests; excludes known-invalid current proof and labels hypotheses.

groups.name: Judge query and case assembly
groups.purpose: Deliver an inspectable case within the bounded query workflow.
groups.receives: Explicit control/run/window selection or a separately validated optional natural-language scope.
groups.produces: A cited case, explicit analysis status and reproducible source/calculation views.
groups.location: Query/investigation entry point plus a local CLI; optional HTML client.

items.name: Judge CLI and optional UI
items.purpose: Accepts explicit scope/profile and stable query identity; distinguishes fresh investigation, recorded-case inspection and offline recheck.

items.name: Scope resolver and snapshot catalog
items.purpose: Resolves full applicable run/window scope and pins event interval, source vector and accepted-input revision; mutable reads cannot silently enter.

items.name: Deterministic case loader / read tools
items.purpose: Provides authorized exact retrieval and bounded list_evidence/get_evidence tools.

items.name: Bounded workflow and deadline controller
items.purpose: Owns durable query/stage claims, original deadline/budgets, duplicate recovery, cancellation liabilities and coherent publication timing.

items.name: Permission-aware query cache
items.purpose: Keys cached results by current authorization, exact scope, source snapshot, accepted-input revision and software/policy versions; labels reused model provenance.

items.name: Constrained case renderer
items.purpose: Renders exact assessment values and source quotes from the validated explanation plan.

items.name: Deterministic fallback and status handler
items.purpose: Separates requested replay/recheck success from degraded fresh analysis, scope limits and evidence insufficiency.

items.name: Source and relationship explorer
items.purpose: Navigates from verdicts to exact captured inputs and from records to typed links, candidates and gaps, reauthorizing pinned drill-downs.

groups.name: ServiceNow governance and human oversight
groups.purpose: Connect measured findings to actual platform records and accountable people.
groups.receives: Control-generated alert/finding intents and optional validated explanatory material.
groups.produces: Remote record IDs, delivery state, named owners and remediation/retest links.
groups.location: Provided ServiceNow AICT/workflow plus our permitted connector and delivery code.

items.name: Team-scoped AICT connection / asset registration
items.purpose: Verifies authorized team connection/assets and separately records trace and finding-route capabilities; naming prefixes do not establish isolation.

items.name: Permitted finding / alert route
items.purpose: Maps deterministic findings and immutable content/routing mutations to a verified authorized workflow; model explanations remain optional.

items.name: Delivery outbox and bounded retries
items.purpose: Preserves required intents, checks dispatch validity, bounds attempts and reconciles ambiguous writes using verified receiver semantics; remains off inference and publication paths.

items.name: Remote ID / status readback
items.purpose: Verifies instance, correlation, intended content revision and named-recipient route; separates acknowledgement, uncertain outcome and dated delivery.

items.name: Owner and human-response tracking
items.purpose: Preserves authoritative recipient/reassignment/actor history and distinguishes covered no-response observations from response uncertainty.

items.name: Remediation and passing-retest linkage
items.purpose: Links real remediation closure to the relevant passing retest and authorized closure; separates authoritative correction/withdrawal while retaining history.

groups.name: Validation campaign and submission packaging
groups.purpose: Prove behavior and produce the required reproducible submission.
groups.receives: Authorized scenarios, actual source/model runs, declared rules and exported evidence.
groups.produces: Test results, benchmark measurements and the six-artifact bundle.
groups.location: Local/test commands and worker/export modules using the same shared package.

items.name: Pass / breach scenario runner
items.purpose: Executes predeclared permitted pass/breach cases with independently expected results, actual IDs and explicit live/replay/fixture provenance.

items.name: Adversarial failure campaign
items.purpose: Challenges missing inputs, conflicts, races, injection, outages and access; retains original failures, fixes and relevant retests.

items.name: Independent arithmetic rechecker
items.purpose: Independently recomputes formulas from captured inputs and frozen rules without calling production evaluators; shared-source authority/completeness remain limitations.

items.name: Model extraction / link quality evaluation
items.purpose: Uses case-grouped held-out references to measure quote/fact/link quality, recall, abstention, coverage and model-versus-template value.

items.name: Latency / freshness / cost benchmark
items.purpose: Measures full fresh/replay/offline outcomes and separate source freshness; retains failures, usage uncertainty and the20-scope repeated-trial readiness gate.

items.name: Bundle exporter and offline index rebuild
items.purpose: Stages a coherent audience-authorized snapshot with critical local inputs, versioned derivatives and a clean offline index rebuild.

items.name: Manifest and release validator
items.purpose: Checks the six usable artifacts, exact release versions, accepted cases and required integrations/tests; readiness stays separate from control satisfaction.

items.name: Judge rehearsal runner
items.purpose: Records two judge-selected answer-and-record rehearsals, profiles, timing, failures and any operator help.

groups.name: Shared platform, security and operational support
groups.purpose: Host the small deployment and make its capabilities, permissions and own behavior visible.
groups.receives: Approved workshop resources, configured identities and runtime state.
groups.produces: Operational entry points, safe storage access, capability status and assurance telemetry.
groups.location: Cross-cutting configuration and modules, not an additional large platform.

items.name: Shared Python distribution and entry points
items.purpose: Packages adapters, worker, query/investigator and optional admission code together.

items.name: Approved compute/runtime configuration
items.purpose: Maps the investigator and workers to permitted workshop hosting; exact capabilities remain unverified.

items.name: State/object/index repository adapters
items.purpose: Conditional mapping to DynamoDB for atomic state, S3 for raw/export objects and SQLite for offline indexing.

items.name: Authentication, authorization and credential configuration
items.purpose: Enforces team isolation and permitted source/model access outside LLM control.

items.name: Assurance-job trace and usage records
items.purpose: Records model/tool calls, versions, timings and failures. Shows separate subject/assurance subtotals and combined spend; policy scope determines inclusion.

items.name: Non-recursion and operational limits
items.purpose: Prevents automatic investigation of the investigator and respects bounded resource policies.

items.name: Capability and gap register
items.purpose: Tracks proposed/tested/verified/unavailable source features, owners and unresolved effects.

items.name: Version/configuration provenance
items.purpose: Pins model/prompt/schema/evaluator/package settings and preserves revision history.

records: Dated rules, owners, versions and applicability.
The whole subject workflow and its lifecycle.
One identified intended execution/admission attempt and its lifecycle; it may be reserved, denied, cancelled or never dispatched. Actual provider executions/charges are separately reconciled.
A link from evidence to control/specification/run or window.
A registered C9 assessment batch and its member runs.
The calculation, exceptions, sufficiency and control verdict.
Delivery, ownership and remediation state around a finding.
The frozen source versions and declared acquisition/completeness state.
The particular accepted facts/bindings used by an assessment.
A model-proposed cited statement and its validation status.
A proposed relationship and corroboration or rejection.
The cited presentation around assessments and unresolved context.
The investigator’s own model/tool activity, budget and timings.
artifacts: Exported evidence, including the investigator’s actual inputs/outputs and validations
Dated threshold specifications and supporting model/configuration policy
Runnable test/query tool and reproduction instructions
Actual named passing/breaching cases and their provenance
One-page diagram matching what was implemented
Known-gap list with owners and effects on the claims
